english.title: Manufacture prohibited weapon - a rocket launcher
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, manufactured a rocket launcher for projecting a stabilised missile, other than a launcher designed for line-throwing or pyrotechnic purposes or as a signalling apparatus
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ae) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without the authority of Secretary of State
manufactured rocket launcher designed for projecting stabilised missile
other than launcher for line-throwing/pyrotechnic purposes/signalling apparatus

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is obsolete - see H6115.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H1741, H1742, H1744, H1745, H1746, H1747 and H1748.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
